geometry: receiver NAV-SAT azimuth/elevation; GPS ephemeris-source and healthy flags required; not independently reconstructed or validated

imu.supplied_attitude: PX4 vehicle_attitude.q FRD→NED, converted to FRD→ENU
imu.specific_force: sensor_combined FRD m/s², already sensor-calibrated; no second board rotation
imu.noise_proxy_interpretation: MAD of differences / 0.95387 on adjacent landed samples; vibration, colour and sensor filtering are not calibrated

motion_model: independent Gaussian acceleration samples; attitude/timing/colour/bias uncertainty uncalibrated
ground_proxy_sensitivity: Maximum axis stationary adjacent-force MAD / 0.9538725524; independent of phase/decisions; not calibrated in-flight noise and not the primary result
label: unknown; land status used for plot stratification only
phase_weights: 0.004 * RAWX cpStd cycles; 15 invalid; 0.001 floor in detector; field covariance uncalibrated

example.selection: maximum primary-offset nonpolynomial motion RMS; independent of phase fit/decision
